newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sahid Jaya active on rights issue talk.
newsitem.headline: Sahid Jaya active on rights issue talk.

text.p: Shares of hotel and property owner PT Sahid Jaya rose sharply on Monday on market speculation of a possible rights issue, brokers said.
Some 9.2 million shares changed hands by late trade and the counter had risen 375 rupiah, or about 13.5 percent, to 1,725 rupiah.
"We are considering a rights issue among other action to finance our expansion programme, but nothing has been finalised yet," company corporate secretary Hari B. Wibisono told Reuters.
The company has said it is planning to develop a vacant plot of land behind the Sahid Jaya Hotel in Jakarta, which would be developed as an integrated apartment, hotel and shopping arcade.
But Wibosono said the company has not made any decision on how it would fund the expansion plan. He said the issue would be discussed in June at its annual general meeting.
